dataset.name: Threshold_Tray_Rectangle_Porcelain
dataset.intended_use: Failure/stress example: flared walls, rounded corners, and feet are outside the uniform-wall enclosure grammar.
dataset.processing: Area-weighted surface sampling of published processed OBJ scan mesh; 12000 samples; NumPy default_rng seed 20261025; coordinates multiplied by 1000 from SDF SI metres to mm. No denoising, alignment, or fitting applied.
dataset.limits: Published mesh is a simplified processed physical scan, not raw sensor input. Reconstructed distances are scan-relative; manufacturing accuracy and hidden structure are unverified. Packaging shell thickness and material are unknown.
